Audio

  • FXSound - Boost sound quality, volume, and bass. Has a beautiful modern UI. 🪟 🟢 ⭐
  • JACK Audio - Audio server for routing and mixing sound between programs. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • EarTrumpet - Advanced volume control for Windows, offering app-specific audio management. 🪟
  • Ambie - Use white noise, nature sounds, & more to boost your productivity. 🪟 🟢
  • BlackHole - Virtual audio loopback driver for routing audio between macOS applications. 🍎 🟢

Audio Players

  • Foobar2000 - Lightweight and highly customizable audio player with support for many formats. 🪟 🍎 ⭐
  • Audacious - Lightweight audio player for simple music playback. 🪟 🐧 🟢
  • Karafun - Collection of karaoke songs across multiple genres. Play your own CDG files or use downloads from YouTube. 🪟
  • MusicBee - Feature-rich music player and manager. 🪟
  • Strawberry Music Player - Music player for organizing and playing your audio collection. 🪟 🍎 🐧

Audio Recording

  • Audacity - Audio editor for recording and editing sounds. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢 ⭐
  • Ocenaudio - Easy-to-use audio editor for recording and analyzing sounds. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Wavosaur - Simple audio editor for recording, editing, and processing sound. 🪟

DJ Software

  • DJ ProDecks - DJ software for mixing music and adding effects. 🪟
  • Mixxx - DJ software for live mixing and beatmatching with controller support. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Serato DJ Lite - DJ software for beginners to mix music with ease. 🪟 🍎
  • Rekordbox - Software that enables a comfortable DJ workflow with AI, cloud, and automation tech. 🪟 🍎
  • VirtualDJ - DJ platform for mixing music, beatmatching, and live performance. 🪟 🍎

Music Notation

  • ABCjs - Tool for writing and playing ABC music notation. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Denemo - Music notation software for fast score creation with LilyPond. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Frescobaldi - Editor for LilyPond to create music scores quickly. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • LilyPond - Music notation program for creating high-quality sheet music. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • MuseScore - Software for creating, playing, and sharing sheet music. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • TuxGuitar - TuxGuitar is an editor and player for multi-track guitar tablatures. It can open Guitar Pro, Power Tab Editor, TablEdit and MIDI files. 🪟 🍎 🐧🟢

Music Production

  • LMMS - DAW for creating music with virtual instruments and MIDI support. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢 ⭐
  • Ardour - DAW for recording, editing, and mixing audio with professional features. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Cakewalk - Full-featured DAW for music recording and editing by BandLab. 🪟
  • Furnace - Multi-system chiptune tracker. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • MilkyTracker - Cross platform XM tracker. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • OpenMPT - Modren tracker software that can open multiple tracker formats. 🪟
  • Qtractor - Multi-track DAW for Linux for audio and MIDI recording. 🐧
  • Stargate DAW - Innovation-first DAW, instrument and effect plugins. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Tracktion T7 - DAW for music production with advanced editing features. 🪟 🍎 🐧

Browsers

  • Tor Browser - Privacy browser routing traffic over the Tor network. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢 ⭐
  • Arc - Vertical tab browser for modern productivity. 🪟 🍎
  • Brave - Privacy-focused and fast browser. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Chrome - Fast browser with integrated Google services. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Chromium - Browser project behind Chrome. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • ungoogled-chromium - Privacy-focused Chromium with Google services removed. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Firefox - Browser with privacy and customization. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • LibreWolf - Privacy-focused Firefox fork with enhanced security. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Microsoft Edge - Chromium-based browser with extra enhancements. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Min - Fast, minimal browser prioritizing privacy. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Opera - Browser with built-in ad-blocking, VPN, and speed. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Pale Moon - Goanna-based browser. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Orion - Lightweight WebKit browser with Chrome/Firefox extension support. 🍎 🐧
  • qutebrowser - Keyboard-driven, vim-like browser in Python and Qt. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Safari - Native Mac browser with Apple device integration. 🍎
  • Station - Browser centralizing web apps in one workspace. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Mullvad Browser - Privacy browser with Tor, anti-fingerprinting, and Mullvad VPN. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Vivaldi - Customizable browser putting you in control. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Zen Browser - Beautifully designed, privacy-focused browser with custom mods. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢

Communication

Messaging

  • Discord - Communication platform for text, voice, and video, popular with gamers. 🪟 🍎 🐧 ⭐
  • Telegram - Cloud-based messaging app known for speed, security, and group chats. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • WhatsApp - Free messaging app with text, voice, video calls, and multimedia sharing. 🪟 🍎
  • Signal - Secure, private messaging app with end-to-end encryption. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Slack - Collaboration hub for teams with messaging, file sharing, and integrations. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Viber - Free messaging app with text, voice, video calls, and file sharing. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Microsoft Teams - Team communication platform with chat, file sharing, and video conferencing. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Skype - Messaging and video call service supporting text, voice, and video. 🪟 🍎 🐧

Email Clients

  • BlueMail - Cross-platform email client with modern interface. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • CanaryMail - Secure email app with PGP support and AI assistance. 🍎 🐧
  • Edison Mail - Customizable, intuitive email client with smart features. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • ElectronMail - Electron-based desktop client for ProtonMail. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Eppie Mail - Open-source email client with local AI agents and full support for Gmail, Outlook, and Proton Mail. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • eM Client - Modern client to boost your productivity. 🪟
  • Foxmail - Fast, user-friendly email client. 🪟 🍎
  • Mailbird - IMAP/POP3 client with customization options. 🪟
  • Mailspring - Beautiful, fast email client. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Nylas Mail - Extensible desktop email app based on web technologies. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Postbox - Advanced email management with productivity focus. 🪟 🍎
  • Polymail - Simple, powerful email client with modern features. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Wino Mail - Fluent design email client with Mica effect. 🪟
  • Spark - Fast email client with team collaboration features. 🍎 🐧
  • ThunderBird - Email client for easier management. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Tutanota - Encrypted service focused on privacy. 🪟 🍎 🐧

Compression and Archiving

  • 7-Zip - Archive manager supporting 7z, ZIP, and other formats. 🪟 🟢 ⭐
  • Bandizip - Fast, lightweight archive manager with extensive format support. 🪟
  • muCommander - Lightweight dual-pane file manager with archive support. 🍎
  • NanaZip - 7-Zip derivative optimized for Windows 10/11 with added functionality. 🪟
  • PDF Archiver - Tool for tagging and organizing PDFs. 🍎 🟢
  • PeaZip - Archive manager supporting 180+ formats with encryption and compression. 🪟 🐧 🟢
  • The Unarchiver - Simple tool for extracting ZIP, RAR, ISO, and other formats. 🍎
  • Unarchive One - Multi-format decompression tool with QuickLook integration. 🍎
  • Keka - File archiver for compressing and extracting common archive formats. 🍎

Customize

System Customization

  • Winaero - All-in-one app for tuning Windows settings. 🪟
  • Windhawk - Customization marketplace for Windows and programs. 🪟 🟢
  • HideVolumeOSD - Hides the Windows volume bar. 🪟 🟢
  • ExplorerPatcher - Restores and enhances the classic taskbar and system elements. 🪟 🟢
  • Flow Launcher - Quick file search and app launcher like Spotlight. 🪟 🟢
  • ModernFlyouts - Replaces default flyouts with customizable modern ones. 🪟 🟢
  • Hidden Bar - Simple app to organize and declutter your menu bar. 🍎 🟢
  • MacPilot - Unlock hidden settings and system tweaks. 🍎
  • noMeiryoUI - Tools to freely change system fonts. 🪟 🟢
  • TaskbarX - Personalize the taskbar with center alignment, transparency, and animations. 🪟
  • TinkerTool - Utility for enabling hidden system preferences. 🍎
  • Sizer - Resize any window to a predefined size. 🪟
  • Sophia Script for Windows - The most powerful PowerShell module for fine-tuning Windows showing how Windows can be configured without making any harm to it. 🪟 🟢
  • RetroBar - Classic Windows 95, 98, Me, 2000, XP, Vista taskbar for modern versions of Windows. 🪟 🟢
  • SaneBar - Menu bar icon manager and organizer. Local-only alternative to Bartender. 🍎 🟢
  • SaneClick - Finder toolbar customizer for adding quick actions. 🍎 🟢
  • Thaw - Menu bar manager for hiding, arranging, and customizing menu bar items. 🍎 🟢

Wallpaper Tools

  • Lively Wallpaper - Tool to set animated and interactive wallpapers. 🪟 🟢 ⭐
  • Rainmeter - Desktop customization tool offering widgets, skins, and live stats. 🪟 🟢 ⭐
  • Komorebi - Animated wallpaper manager. 🐧 🟢
  • Plash - App to set websites as wallpapers. 🍎 🟢
  • ScreenPlay - Wallpaper and widget engine. 🪟 🐧 🟢
  • Variety - Wallpaper changer with features for downloading and managing wallpapers. 🐧 🟢
  • WinDynamicDesktop - Port of macOS Mojave Dynamic Desktop feature to Windows. 🪟 🟢
  • Sucrose - Versatile wallpaper engine bringing life to your desktop with a wide range of interactive themes. 🪟 🟢

Data Management

Copy and Move

  • FastCopy - Copy and move files in batch. 🪟
  • TeraCopy - Copy and move multiple files. 🪟 🍎
  • Blip - Direct file transfer app with unlimited file sizes, folder support, and transfer resume. 🪟 🍎 ⭐

Sync and Clone

  • FreeFileSync - Tool for comparing and syncing files or folders. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢 ⭐
  • rclone - Command-line tool for managing and syncing files with cloud storage. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Syncthing - Continuous file synchronization for multiple computers. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢

Developer Tools

  • livewinsize - Visualize window size in pixels and other units. 🪟 🟢 ⭐
  • Diffinity - Diff and merging tool with focus on accurate and easy-to-read source code diffs. 🪟
  • Meld - Tool for visual file, directory, and version control comparison. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • TkForge - Drag & drop in Figma to create a Python GUI with ease. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢 ⭐
  • WinMerge - Windows visual diff and merge for files and directories. 🪟 🟢
  • WhereMyTokens - Windows system tray app for monitoring Claude Code token usage in real time. Displays per-session token counts, costs, context window usage, and rate limits. 🪟 🟢
  • Headroom - Native macOS menu bar app showing Claude Code's session (5h) and weekly (7d) rate-limit usage as a live %, with color-coded alerts, reset countdowns, context window fill, active model name, and session cost. Zero network calls. 🍎 🟢
  • x64dbg - Debugger for Windows. 🪟 🟢
  • Ghostty - Fast native terminal emulator with GPU acceleration, tabs, splits, and modern terminal features. 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • iTerm2 - Terminal replacement for macOS with split panes, profiles, search, and extensive customization. 🍎 🟢
  • Ollama - Runs and manages local AI models with desktop and command-line tools. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Android Studio - Official IDE for Android development with emulator, code editor, and build tools. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • GitHub Desktop - Graphical Git client for cloning repositories, reviewing changes, and syncing with GitHub. 🪟 🍎 🟢
  • WezTerm - GPU-accelerated terminal emulator and multiplexer with tabs, panes, SSH, and Lua configuration. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Tura - Local-first AI coding agent with persistent parallel sessions, desktop and terminal interfaces, and local-model support. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢

API Development

  • Insomnia - Simple API client for REST and GraphQL development. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢 ⭐
  • Postman - API development platform with advanced testing and collaboration tools. 🪟 🍎 🐧 ⭐
  • Apidog - All-in-one workspace for API design, testing, and documentation. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Bruno - Offline API client that is fast, Git-friendly, and open source. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Cocoa Rest Client - Native app for testing REST APIs. 🍎 🟢
  • Hoppscotch - Lightweight API development tool for designing, testing, and debugging. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • HTTPie - Command-line and GUI tool to simplify working with APIs. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • HTTP Toolkit - Tool for debugging and mocking HTTP requests. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Katalon Studio - Testing automation for APIs, web, and mobile apps. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Mockoon - Desktop tool for creating and testing mock REST APIs. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • SoapUI Open Source - For testing REST and SOAP APIs with scripting support. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Paw - Advanced HTTP client. 🍎
  • Yaak - An offline and Git friendly API tester for HTTP, GraphQL, WebSockets, SSE, and gRPC. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Endpoint - Native macOS API client with WebSocket support, performance testing, and customizable themes. 🍎

Database

  • DBeaver - Universal database tool for SQL databases like MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Apache Family, and more. 🪟 🍎 🐧 ⭐
  • Beekeeper Studio - Modern, lightweight SQL client supporting MySQL, Postgres, SQLite, SQL Server, etc. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • DB Browser for SQLite - Visual tool for creating, browsing, and editing SQLite database files. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • DearSQL - Lightweight native database client built with Dear ImGui, supporting SQL and NoSQL databases. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢

Network Analysis

  • Wireshark - Leading tool for capturing and analyzing network traffic. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢 ⭐
  • Burp Suite Community Edition - Class-leading vulnerability scanning and web app security. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Charles - Debugging proxy to view HTTP and HTTPS traffic. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • James - Proxy for intercepting HTTP/HTTPS requests. 🪟 🍎 🟢
  • mitmproxy - Interactive HTTP proxy for debugging and penetration testing. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Proxie - HTTP debugging proxy for tracking requests. 🍎
  • Proxyman - Modern HTTP proxy with an intuitive UI. 🍎
  • Sniffnet - Tool for monitoring and analyzing network traffic. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢

Game Engines

  • Godot - Game engine for 2D and 3D games with an easy-to-learn scripting language. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢 ⭐
  • Unreal Engine - Powerful, fully-featured game engine for high-quality 3D games. 🪟 🍎 🐧 ⭐
  • Amazon Lumberyard - Free, cross-platform 3D game engine integrated with AWS and Twitch for multiplayer games. 🪟 🍎
  • AppGameKit - Flexible game engine for 2D and 3D games with simple scripting. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Cocos2d - Game engine for mobile and web games, focused on 2D games. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Defold - Cross-platform 2D game engine with easy-to-use tools. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • CryEngine - Advanced game engine with cutting-edge graphics and tools for creating visually stunning games. 🪟
  • Flixel - 2D engine built with Haxe, suitable for platformers and action games. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • GDevelop - No-code engine for creating 2D games with a visual event system. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Gosu - Simple 2D game development library for Ruby or C++. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • LÖVE - Simple, easy-to-learn 2D game engine for Lua. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • LÖVR - Simple 3D game engine for Lua, inspired by LÖVE. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Monogame - Framework for cross-platform game development with C#. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • OpenRA - Game engine for real-time strategy games, supporting mods for classic titles. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • PICO-8 - Fantasy console for making retro-style small games. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Ren'Py - Popular engine for creating visual novels with a simple scripting language. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Pixel Game Maker MV - Game creation engine for 2D pixel games with no coding required. 🪟
  • Roblox Studio - Engine for making games on Roblox. 🪟 🍎
  • Scirra Construct - Powerful game engine with drag-and-drop and visual scripting for 2D games. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Tiled - Level editor for creating tile-based game maps, used with other engines. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Unity - Popular game engine for creating both 2D and 3D games, with an intuitive interface and wide asset store. 🪟 🍎 🐧

Virtualization

  • Docker - Containerization platform for operating-system-level virtualization. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢 ⭐
  • VirtualBox - Virtualization software for creating and managing virtual machines. 🪟 🍎 🐧 ⭐
  • Lima - Tool for launching Linux VMs with file sharing and port forwarding. 🍎 🟢
  • Multipass - Quickly launch and manage Ubuntu virtual machines on demand. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • OrbStack - Lightweight and fast virtualization for running Docker containers and Linux machines. 🍎
  • Podman Desktop - Desktop alternative to Docker for managing containers. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • QEMU - Emulator and virtualizer for hardware and system virtualization. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Rancher Desktop - App for managing containers and Kubernetes on desktop. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • UTM - GUI for QEMU to run various VMs including ARM64 and x64. 🍎
  • Vagrant - Tool for managing reproducible development environments using virtual machines. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • VMWare Workstation - Virtualization software with advanced features. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • eryph-zero - Tool for building VMs as if they were running in the cloud, but locally on Windows. 🪟 🟢
  • Mocker - Docker-compatible container CLI for macOS built on Apple's Containerization framework. 🍎 🟢

Documents

  • CDisplayEx - Lightweight comic book reader (.cbr, .cbz, .pdf, manga). 🪟

Office Suites

  • LibreOffice - Popular and easy to use office suite. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢 ⭐
  • Apache OpenOffice - Suite for documents, spreadsheets, etc. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Calligra Suite - Office suite with word processing and vector graphics. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Collabora Online - Cloud-based LibreOffice for collaboration. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Etherpad - Real-time collaborative text editor. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • FreeOffice - Suite with compatibility for MS Office formats. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Google Workspace - Cloud-based suite for document collaboration. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • OnlyOffice - Office suite with collaboration features. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • WPS Office - Lightweight office suite compatible with MS file formats. 🪟 🍎 🐧

E-book

  • Calibre - Powerful e-book manager. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢 ⭐
  • iChm - CHM reader. 🍎 🟢
  • Kindle App - Official Kindle reader app. 🪟 🍎
  • Klib - Manage Kindle and iBooks highlights. 🍎
  • IReader Free and open source novel reader for Android and Desktop
  • Koodo Reader - EBook reader supporting 15+ formats. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Naps2 - Scan documents to PDF and more, as simply as possible. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Readest - Cross-platform eBook reader with tools. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Scribus - Layout and publishing software. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Sigil - EPUB editor. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Simple Comic - Reader for PDF, CBZ, and CBR formats. 🍎
  • KOReader - KOReader is a document viewer for E Ink devices. 🐧 🟢

PDF Tools

  • Sumatra PDF - Fast, lightweight PDF reader. 🪟 🟢 ⭐
  • Foxit PDF Reader - PDF viewer with annotations. 🪟 🍎
  • MuPDF - Powerful PDF viewer. 🪟 🐧 🟢
  • Okular - Universal document viewer by KDE. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • PDF Arranger - PDF editor for splitting, merging. 🪟 🐧 🟢
  • PDF24 - Easy PDF tools. 🪟
  • qpdfview - Tabbed document viewer. 🐧 🟢
  • Skim - PDF viewer for annotation. 🍎 🟢
  • Xournal++ - Handwriting and annotation tool for PDFs. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • PDFGear - Read, edit, convert, merge, and sign PDF files across devices. 🪟 🍎
  • PDFsam - Extract pages, split, merge, mix and rotate PDF files. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • qpdf - A content-preserving PDF document transformer. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • pdfcpu - A PDF processor written in Go. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Stirling-PDF - #1 PDF Application on GitHub that lets you edit PDFs on any device anywhere. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • pdftk - PDFtk is a simple tool for doing everyday things with PDF documents. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • PDFluent - Offline PDF editor for forms, OCR, redaction, signatures, conversion, and page management on Windows and macOS. 🪟 🍎

Note Taking

  • Inkless - Minimal, shortcut based app to take notes and use for light coding. 🪟 🟢 ⭐
  • Obsidian - Knowledge base app with powerful linking and markdown support. 🪟 🍎 🐧 ⭐
  • Craft Docs - Beautiful and powerful tool for creating and organizing documents and notes. 🪟 🍎
  • Joplin - Capture your thoughts and securely access them from any device. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Logseq - Privacy-first, open-source platform for knowledge management and collaboration. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Notion - All-in-one workspace for notes, tasks, databases, and collaboration. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Plain Text Editor - Simple, distraction-free text editor for quick note-taking. 🍎
  • Tot - Simple, elegant app for collecting and editing text snippets. 🍎
  • RemNote - Knowledge management app with note-taking and spaced repetition features. 🪟 🍎 🐧
  • Simplenote - Minimalist note-taking app that syncs across devices. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • qnote - Minimal frameless notepad with Markdown preview, real PDF export via Typst, OCR via Tesseract, and automatic version history. 🐧 🟢
  • fylepad - Lightweight notepad with powerful rich-text editing. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • plumio - Privacy-first, open-source, self-hostable notes-taking app. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Xournal++ - Take handwritten notes with ease. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • RNote - Sketch and take handwritten notes. . 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Trilium Notes - Organize your thoughts. Build your personal knowledge base. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Snoq - Secure, offline-first note-taking app with AES-256 encryption. 🪟
  • Knopo - Local-first outliner for plain Markdown notes with backlinks, page/block references, and graph-friendly files. 🍎 🟢
  • Bangle.io - Local-first WYSIWYG note-taking app that keeps notes as portable Markdown files. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢

Text Editors

  • Visual Studio Code - Code editor with debugging, integrated Git support, and a vast extension marketplace. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢 ⭐
  • Atom - Highly customizable editor with Git integration, real-time collaboration, and extensive plugins. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Bluefish - Web developer editor supporting HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP with built-in preview. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Brackets - Web-focused editor with live preview, CSS preprocessor support, and inline editing for HTML. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • CodeEdit - Native macOS editor with live preview, Git integration, and Markdown support. 🍎 🟢
  • CotEditor - Text editor with syntax highlighting, snippets, and regular expression search. 🍎 🟢
  • Emacs - Customizable editor with robust scripting, project management, and multi-language support. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
  • Fastedit - Minimal text editor with a frost glass background and basic text editing tools. 🪟 🟢
  • FluentEdit - Simple code editor with a Fluent design, featuring split view and customizable themes. 🪟
  • Geany - Lightweight editor with built-in terminal, project management, and syntax highlighting for many languages. 🪟 🍎 🐧 🟢
